record.body:
## Interfaces

RequirementDetailScreen(target, effort, phase, requirement) is the constructor in dashboard/requirement_detail.py. Phase detail pushes it with the phase subject and the requirement row id. Needs you pushes it for a loop-route item with that item's phase and requirement. Task detail pushes it from a req:<phase>:<id> link using the task's effort. Decision rows use decision:<subject> and the handler does not navigate them. TaskDetail.requirements and TaskDetail.decisions are the payload strings already on the work-item get; load_task_detail still makes four CLI calls (test_detail_uses_four_cli_calls passed).

## Assumptions

Comma-separated requirements and decisions split on commas with whitespace trimmed. The task pilot uses "R1, R2" and "pick-a, pick-b" and shows both. Requirement text still comes from R<n>: lines; the opened screens showed "text of R1".

## Invariants

Status still comes only from the latest assessment. Model tests selected with -k evidence passed. A phase with no specification still renders the previous frame (test_evidence_simple_phase_matches_the_previous_frame passed). The dashboard stays read-only. Existing task, phase, and Needs-you task links still open: tests/test_dashboard_app.py and tests/test_dashboard_requirement.py selected with 'link and not evidence or requirement' passed 27.

## Conflicts

none
